hints.title: Sieve Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute all prime numbers up to n using the sieve of Eratosthenes.

hints.title: Symmetric Complement Search
hints.text: For each candidate prime x up to n divided by two, check if n minus x is also prime.

hints.title: Sorted Order Collection
hints.text: Collect valid pairs [x, n - x] in increasing order of x.

hints.title: Sieve Verification Code

complexity.notes: Sieve of Eratosthenes computes primes up to n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing primality individually for each pair takes O(n * sqrt(n)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean array of size n provides constant-time primality queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses Sieve of Eratosthenes and bounds the check to n // 2.
